mapper.select: SELECT qg.id AS id, qg.name AS name, qg.LEVEL AS level, qg.game_id AS gameId, qg.remark AS remark, qg.coins AS coins, qg.extract AS extract, qg.status AS status, qg.ip AS ip, qg.port AS port, qg.ori_coins AS oriCoins, qg.player_count AS playerCount FROM t_group_game qg, t_game g WHERE qg.game_id = g.game_id AND qg.game_id = #{gameId} AND qg.status = "1" AND qg.level IS NOT NULL AND g.status = "2"

SELECT qg.id AS id, qg.level AS level, qg.game_id AS gameId, qg.extract AS extract, qg.ip AS ip, qg.port AS port, qg.ori_coins AS oriCoins, qg.player_count AS playerCount FROM ( t_group_game qg LEFT JOIN t_game g ON qg.game_id = g.game_id ) WHERE qg.game_id IS NOT NULL AND qg.status = "1" AND qg.level IS NOT NULL AND g.status = "2"
